english.note: This is the all-purpose term for a film or game soundtrack, including the music itself and its released recording.

examples.english: The soundtrack of this film is great, so I bought a copy right after watching it.
examples.traditional: 呢套戲嘅原聲帶好好聽，我睇完即刻買咗張返屋企。
